faq.guideIntro: Step-by-step help and detailed answers are in the guide.
faq.a1: Start with one activity, such as reading or building. Choose a future time on the calendar and add a plan. Afterward, record the time you actually spent. Repeat from there.
faq.q2: How are plans and records different?
faq.a2: A plan is how you hope to spend time. A record is what actually happened. Plans do not automatically become records, and the original plan stays when you create a record from it.
faq.q3: Do I need to record my whole day?
faq.a3: No. Start with the time you care about. You choose what to keep.
faq.a4: Existing plans are not rewritten from your records. When you apply a template, recent records can guide the lengths of new plans, which you can edit afterward.
faq.q5: Do I have to connect an AI?
faq.a5: No. Planning, recording, and reviewing work in Dayopt alone. Connect an MCP-compatible AI only if you want to.
faq.q6: Can I take my data with me?
faq.a6: You can export your data as CSV or JSON from Settings.
